description: Function ownership/name map for the MSVC-oriented source restructure. It combines current coverage ownership, historical address names, the historical pure-C++ exact-match ledger, and Ghidra full/augmented/raw body partitions. Unknown extra functions remain unidentified; inferred ownership is never promoted to a source fact.

target.compiler: MSVC 13.10.6030 (C++98 and inline assembly); ownership metadata recovered from the modern C++ tree
target.inventory_policy: union of Ghidra index and historical overlay addresses (inventory only)

machine_code_anchor_provenance.role: The generated instruction rows and encoded comments authenticate instruction starts/bytes used by the assembly baseline; they do not promote recovered code gaps to function definitions.

policy.historical_overlay_warning: Historical address inventory only; membership does not establish implementation or retail equivalence.
policy.unknown_extra_code: retain entry with preferred_module_path=null and ownership_status=unidentified
policy.coverage_owner_precedence: A current coverage source path is authoritative for ownership. The historical overlay object is retained as naming/inventory evidence only; it never supplies a source path for an entry whose coverage source is unrecovered.
policy.edge_start_policy: Instruction starts introduced by text_code_edges.json are byte-boundary corrections only and must not be promoted to function definitions.
policy.physical_range_policy: body_ranges are the augmented Ghidra physical partition. Multi-range claims are retained as claims; no original translation unit is inferred for an unidentified entry.

evidence: authenticated retail bytes decode linearly from 0x004014D0 as XOR ECX,ECX; MOV [EAX+0x896C],ECX; MOV [EAX+0x8970],ECX; INC [EAX+0x8990]; MOV EAX,1; RET
objdump -Mintel over the retail PE emits INC dword ptr [EAX+0x8990] at 0x004014DE and MOV EAX,1 at 0x004014E4
IDA source has sibling sub_4014F0 with the same field-reset/increment/return body using ECX; this block is the EAX-input sibling immediately after CC alignment
export rows at 0x004014E0/0x004014E1/0x004014E3 are semantically split tails of the INC displacement and MOV immediate; they are explicitly replaced
authenticated retail bytes and live Ghidra disassemble_bytes from 0x00438973 decode PUSH 0x46F7C8 (68 C8 F7 46 00)
the surrounding call sequence pushes 0x10, this, and 0 before the imported call at 0x0043897B; PUSH 0x46F7C8 is the missing second argument
IDA source labels the function at 0x00438974, but its ENTER 0x46F7,0 row starts on the immediate bytes of the preceding PUSH and is replaced
authenticated retail bytes decode as MOV EAX,dword ptr [ESP+0x1C] (8B 44 24 1C)
FUN_00464110 context stores FNSTCW word ptr [ESP+0x1C] at 0x00464154, then must reload that saved control word before bit masking; the replacement provides that reload
Ghidra/IDA export rows at 0x0046415A decode only the displacement tail 24 1C as AND AL,0x1C and are explicitly replaced
callers/xrefs into FUN_00464110 are present throughout 0x0046426F-0x0046490C, confirming this is active CRT floating-point code
The live code recovery overlay decoded byte 44 at 0x00464159 as INC ESP; this is also explicitly retired because it is the ModR/M byte of the restored MOV.

unassigned_code_definition: unassigned_code_ranges are instruction extents without an independent callable anchor in the augmented index. Edge-correction spans may overlap a superseded body range; they remain unassigned as entry anchors and carry must_not_define_function=true.
